source_refs.note: Exercise 14.2, Question 2 (i)-(ii): projections (book p.274). Key (PDF 311-312) prints vector projections; 14.2.3 defines the scalar; both given, correction callout.

blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Calculate the projection of \(\underline{a}\) along \(\underline{b}\) and projection of \(\underline{b}\) along \(\underline{a}\) when: \(\underline{a} = 2\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} - \underline{k}\), \(\underline{b} = \underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 4\underline{k}\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein do projections maange gaye hain: \(\underline{a}\) ka \(\underline{b}\) ke along, aur \(\underline{b}\) ka \(\underline{a}\) ke along.
Projection ko aise samjhiye: \(\underline{b}\) ki line zameen par pari hai aur upar se seedhi roshni aa rahi hai; \(\underline{a}\) ka saaya (shadow) us line par jitna lamba parta hai, wohi projection hai.
Rule kaunsa? 14.2.3: projection of \(\underline{a}\) along \(\underline{b}\) \(= \frac{\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}}{|\underline{b}|}\). Jis vector ke 'along' projection chahiye, usi ki length se divide hota hai.
Plan: ek dot product, do lengths, do divisions; phir answer key wali vector shakal bhi.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{a} = 2\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} - \underline{k}\), \(\underline{b} = \underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 4\underline{k}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\underline{a}\) ka \(\underline{b}\) ke along projection aur \(\underline{b}\) ka \(\underline{a}\) ke along projection.
Tareeqa: \(\underline{a}\) along \(\underline{b}\) \(= |\underline{a}|\cos\theta = \dfrac{\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}}{|\underline{b}|}\), kyunke \(\cos\theta = \frac{\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}}{|\underline{a}||\underline{b}|}\) mein \(|\underline{a}|\) cancel ho jata hai. Isi tarah \(\underline{b}\) along \(\underline{a}\) \(= \dfrac{\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}}{|\underline{a}|}\). Yeh number (scalar) hai. Agar isay us line ke unit vector se multiply karein to saaya ek arrow ban jata hai: yeh vector projection hai, aur answer key yehi shakal deti hai.

Dot product nikalein
\[\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b} = (2)(1) + (3)(-2) + (-1)(4)\]
\[= 2 - 6 - 4 = -8\]
Kyun: Dono projections ke upar (numerator mein) wohi \(\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}\) aata hai, is liye isay ek hi dafa nikal lete hain. Matching components multiply kar ke jama kiye.
Dot product negative aaya, yani angle obtuse hai. Is ka matlab hai ke saaya ulti taraf girega aur dono projections negative honge. Negative jawab ghalti nahi hai.

Dono lengths nikalein
\[|\underline{a}| = \sqrt{4 + 9 + 1} = \sqrt{14}\]
\[|\underline{b}| = \sqrt{1 + 4 + 16} = \sqrt{21}\]
Kyun: Length ka formula \(\sqrt{x^2 + y^2 + z^2}\) hai. Do alag divisions ke liye dono lengths chahiye.
Dhyan dein: Har component ka square karein, minus wale ka bhi; square hamesha positive hota hai.

\(\underline{a}\) ka \(\underline{b}\) ke along projection
\[\dfrac{\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}}{|\underline{b}|} = \dfrac{-8}{\sqrt{21}}\]
\[\text{Vector: } \dfrac{-8}{21}(\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 4\underline{k})\]
\[= -\dfrac{8}{21}\underline{i} + \dfrac{16}{21}\underline{j} - \dfrac{32}{21}\underline{k}\]
Kyun: 'Along \(\underline{b}\)' ka matlab hai \(\underline{b}\) ki line par saaya, is liye \(|\underline{b}|\) se divide kiya. Vector shakal ke liye is number ko \(\underline{b}\) ke unit vector \(\frac{\underline{b}}{|\underline{b}|}\) se multiply kiya, jis se \(\frac{\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}}{|\underline{b}|^2}\underline{b}\) bana.
Dhyan dein: Students aksar ghalat length se divide kar dete hain. Yaad rakhiye: 'along' ke baad jo vector likha ho, usi ki length neeche aati hai.

\(\underline{b}\) ka \(\underline{a}\) ke along projection
\[\dfrac{\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}}{|\underline{a}|} = \dfrac{-8}{\sqrt{14}}\]
\[\text{Vector: } \dfrac{-8}{14}(2\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} - \underline{k})\]
\[= -\dfrac{8}{7}\underline{i} - \dfrac{12}{7}\underline{j} + \dfrac{4}{7}\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Upar wohi dot product hai, lekin ab saaya \(\underline{a}\) ki line par chahiye, is liye \(|\underline{a}|\) se divide kiya. Vector shakal \(\frac{\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}}{|\underline{a}|^2}\underline{a}\) hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\tfrac{8}{21}|\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 4\underline{k}|\]
\[= \tfrac{8\sqrt{21}}{21} = \tfrac{8}{\sqrt{21}}\]
\[\tfrac{8}{14}|2\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} - \underline{k}|\]
\[= \tfrac{8\sqrt{14}}{14} = \tfrac{8}{\sqrt{14}}\]
Kyun: Vector projection ki length hamesha number wale projection ke barabar (size mein) honi chahiye. Yahan dono barabar aaye, is liye hisaab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(\underline{a}\) ka \(\underline{b}\) ke along projection \(= \frac{-8}{\sqrt{21}}\) (vector shakal \(-\frac{8}{21}\underline{i} + \frac{16}{21}\underline{j} - \frac{32}{21}\underline{k}\)); \(\underline{b}\) ka \(\underline{a}\) ke along projection \(= \frac{-8}{\sqrt{14}}\) (vector shakal \(-\frac{8}{7}\underline{i} - \frac{12}{7}\underline{j} + \frac{4}{7}\underline{k}\))

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Calculate the projection of \(\underline{a}\) along \(\underline{b}\) and projection of \(\underline{b}\) along \(\underline{a}\) when: \(\underline{a} = 4\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{b} = \underline{i} + \underline{j} + \underline{k}\)
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein do projections maange gaye hain: \(\underline{a}\) ka \(\underline{b}\) ke along, aur \(\underline{b}\) ka \(\underline{a}\) ke along.
Projection ko aise samjhiye: \(\underline{b}\) ki line zameen par pari hai aur upar se seedhi roshni aa rahi hai; \(\underline{a}\) ka saaya (shadow) us line par jitna lamba parta hai, wohi projection hai.
Rule kaunsa? 14.2.3: projection of \(\underline{a}\) along \(\underline{b}\) \(= \frac{\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}}{|\underline{b}|}\). Jis vector ke 'along' projection chahiye, usi ki length se divide hota hai.
Plan: ek dot product, do lengths, do divisions; phir answer key wali vector shakal bhi.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{a} = 4\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{b} = \underline{i} + \underline{j} + \underline{k}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\underline{a}\) ka \(\underline{b}\) ke along projection aur \(\underline{b}\) ka \(\underline{a}\) ke along projection.
Tareeqa: \(\underline{a}\) along \(\underline{b}\) \(= |\underline{a}|\cos\theta = \dfrac{\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}}{|\underline{b}|}\), kyunke \(\cos\theta = \frac{\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}}{|\underline{a}||\underline{b}|}\) mein \(|\underline{a}|\) cancel ho jata hai. Isi tarah \(\underline{b}\) along \(\underline{a}\) \(= \dfrac{\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}}{|\underline{a}|}\). Yeh number (scalar) hai. Agar isay us line ke unit vector se multiply karein to saaya ek arrow ban jata hai: yeh vector projection hai, aur answer key yehi shakal deti hai.

Dot product nikalein
\[\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b} = (4)(1) + (-2)(1) + (3)(1)\]
\[= 4 - 2 + 3 = 5\]
Kyun: Dono projections ke upar (numerator mein) wohi \(\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}\) aata hai, is liye isay ek hi dafa nikal lete hain. Matching components multiply kar ke jama kiye.
Is dafa dot product positive hai, yani angle acute hai aur dono saaye seedhi taraf girenge: dono projections positive honge.

Dono lengths nikalein
\[|\underline{a}| = \sqrt{16 + 4 + 9} = \sqrt{29}\]
\[|\underline{b}| = \sqrt{1 + 1 + 1} = \sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: Length ka formula \(\sqrt{x^2 + y^2 + z^2}\) hai. Do alag divisions ke liye dono lengths chahiye.
Dhyan dein: Har component ka square karein, minus wale ka bhi; square hamesha positive hota hai.

\(\underline{a}\) ka \(\underline{b}\) ke along projection
\[\dfrac{\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}}{|\underline{b}|} = \dfrac{5}{\sqrt{3}}\]
\[\text{Vector: } \dfrac{5}{3}(\underline{i} + \underline{j} + \underline{k})\]
\[= \dfrac{5}{3}\underline{i} + \dfrac{5}{3}\underline{j} + \dfrac{5}{3}\underline{k}\]
Kyun: 'Along \(\underline{b}\)' ka matlab hai \(\underline{b}\) ki line par saaya, is liye \(|\underline{b}|\) se divide kiya. Vector shakal ke liye is number ko \(\underline{b}\) ke unit vector \(\frac{\underline{b}}{|\underline{b}|}\) se multiply kiya, jis se \(\frac{\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}}{|\underline{b}|^2}\underline{b}\) bana.
Dhyan dein: Students aksar ghalat length se divide kar dete hain. Yaad rakhiye: 'along' ke baad jo vector likha ho, usi ki length neeche aati hai.

\(\underline{b}\) ka \(\underline{a}\) ke along projection
\[\dfrac{\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}}{|\underline{a}|} = \dfrac{5}{\sqrt{29}}\]
\[\text{Vector: } \dfrac{5}{29}(4\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k})\]
\[= \dfrac{20}{29}\underline{i} - \dfrac{10}{29}\underline{j} + \dfrac{15}{29}\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Upar wohi dot product hai, lekin ab saaya \(\underline{a}\) ki line par chahiye, is liye \(|\underline{a}|\) se divide kiya. Vector shakal \(\frac{\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}}{|\underline{a}|^2}\underline{a}\) hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\tfrac{5}{3}|\underline{i} + \underline{j} + \underline{k}|\]
\[= \tfrac{5\sqrt{3}}{3} = \tfrac{5}{\sqrt{3}}\]
\[\tfrac{5}{29}|4\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}|\]
\[= \tfrac{5\sqrt{29}}{29} = \tfrac{5}{\sqrt{29}}\]
Kyun: Vector projection ki length hamesha number wale projection ke barabar (size mein) honi chahiye. Yahan dono barabar aaye, is liye hisaab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(\underline{a}\) ka \(\underline{b}\) ke along projection \(= \frac{5}{\sqrt{3}}\) (vector shakal \(\frac{5}{3}\underline{i} + \frac{5}{3}\underline{j} + \frac{5}{3}\underline{k}\)); \(\underline{b}\) ka \(\underline{a}\) ke along projection \(= \frac{5}{\sqrt{29}}\) (vector shakal \(\frac{20}{29}\underline{i} - \frac{10}{29}\underline{j} + \frac{15}{29}\underline{k}\))

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key (PDF 311-312) sirf vectors likhti hai, maslan \(-\frac{8}{21}\underline{i} + \frac{16}{21}\underline{j} - \frac{32}{21}\underline{k}\). Yeh vector projections hain. Lekin kitab ka apna section 14.2.3 projection ko ek number kehta hai: \(\frac{\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}}{|\underline{b}|}\). Is hisaab se (i) mein jawab \(\frac{-8}{\sqrt{21}}\) aur \(\frac{-8}{\sqrt{14}}\), aur (ii) mein \(\frac{5}{\sqrt{3}}\) aur \(\frac{5}{\sqrt{29}}\) hain. Upar dono shaklein di gayi hain. Exam mein number zaroor likhiye, aur agar vector maanga ho to vector shakal bhi.
